description_en: Queries the execution status of an execution plan
description_zh: 查询执行计划的执行情况
name: ListActionPlanActivities

parameters.help_en: The ID of the execution plan
parameters.name: action_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

ActionPlanActivities.description_en: The list of execution details of the execution plan
ActionPlanActivities.description_zh: 执行计划执行详情列表

items.description_en: The execution details of the execution plan

ActionPlanActivityId.description_en: The activity ID of the execution plan

CreatedCapacity.description_en: The increased capacity of this execution plan activity
CreatedCapacity.description_zh: 本次执行计划活动增加的容量

DestroyCapacity.description_en: The capacity released by this execution plan activity
DestroyCapacity.description_zh: 本次执行计划活动释放的容量

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the execution plan activity
EndTime.description_zh: 执行计划活动实施结束时间

Jobs.description_en: The list of Instant jobs involved in the execution plan
Jobs.description_zh: 本次执行计划执行涉及到的Instant作业信息列表

items.description_en: The information about the Instant jobs involved in the execution plan
items.description_zh: 本次执行计划执行涉及到的Instant作业信息

JobOperationType.description_en:
The operation type of the execution plan activity on the job. Possible values are as follows:

Create
Delete
JobOperationType.description_zh:
本次执行计划活动对作业的操作类型，可能值如下：

Create：创建Instant作业；

Delete：删除作业；

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the implementation of the planned activity
StartTime.description_zh: 执行计划活动实施开始时间

Status.description_en:
The implementation status of the execution plan activity. Valid values:

InProcess
Completed
Failed
Status.description_zh:
执行计划活动实施状态。取值范围：

InProcess：进行中；

Completed：已完成；

Failed：失败；

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records returned in this request
MaxResults.description_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
MaxResults.title_en: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
MaxResults.title_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数

NextToken.description_en: Indicates the read position returned by the current call. An empty value means all data has been read

NextToken.title_en: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
